defect: clock-gating enable from a configuration domain directly gates the worker clock

mutation.description: A level generated in clk_cfg is ANDed with clk_main without a same-domain integrated clock-gating latch or synchronizer.

rationale: The enable can change while clk_main is high, producing a runt pulse or truncating a worker cycle; the generated clock constraint does not make the gate safe.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.note: Asynchronous enable drives an AND clock gate without low-phase storage, allowing truncated and spurious clock pulses.
